"I retired your father" 🤯

@RandyOrton is taking @CodyRhodes down memory lane! https://t.co/TZMM0CLZyt

transcript.text: We have never brought up the fact that your father and I wrestled in 2007 at the Great
American Bash in a Texas bull rope match. I retired your father. His last match was with
me and I literally rang his bell and then I kicked him in the head and I was the last
man standing at Crown Jewel. You can call me the Viper, the apex predator, the legend killer,
the last man standing. You can call me the Rhodes killer if you'd like. But if, if,
if Cody, your American dream was to be just like your daddy
then Saturday at Crown Jewel, I'm gonna make sure that dream comes true.
